mailings.create.envelopes.note: U:quill/mailings: wordcraft ribbon/mailings.rs and dialogs_layout/print.rs: the Envelopes dialog (delivery and return address, size) with Add to Document and New Document. Word's Labels tab, Options… and electronic postage are not upstream and stay hidden; Labels is its own control.

mailings.create.labels.note: U:quill/mailings: dialogs_layout/print.rs labels_ui: address or one label per recipient, the label product, a full page or a single label at a row and column; New Document makes the sheet. No printing; Word's Options… (vendors and product numbers) and Envelopes tab are not upstream.

mailings.start-mail-merge.start-mail-mer.note: U:quill/mailings: the kinds upstream makes (Letters, E-mail Messages, Envelopes, Labels, Directory, Normal Word Document; the current one checked; saved in the .docx as w:mailMerge). Hidden (no upstream engine): Step-by-Step Mail Merge Wizard…

mailings.start-mail-merge.select-recipie.note: U:quill/mailings: ribbon/mailings.rs: Type a New List… (the Recipient List dialog with empty fields) and Use an Existing List… (the system Open dialog: CSV, TSV, text, .xlsx, .xlsm, .ods; a workbook with several sheets asks which). Hidden (no upstream engine): Choose from Outlook Contacts…; .xls workbooks are refused with a message.

mailings.write-insert-fields.insert-merg.note: U:quill/mailings: the button opens Insert Merge Field (the list's fields); the arrow lists the fields of the recipient list as Word does and inserts the one picked.

mailings.write-insert-fields.rules.note: U:quill/mailings: ribbon/mailings.rs and dialogs/dispatch.rs merge_rule_dialog: If…Then…Else…, Merge Record #, Next Record and Skip Record If…; Next Record If… uses the engine's NEXTIF with the same form. Hidden (no upstream engine): Ask…, Fill-in…, Merge Sequence #, Set Bookmark….

mailings.write-insert-fields.address-blo.note: U:quill/mailings: ribbon/mailings.rs: inserts an ADDRESSBLOCK field (name, company, street, city line, country from the matched fields) directly, as upstream does; Word's Insert Address Block dialog with its format choices is not upstream and stays out.

mailings.write-insert-fields.greeting-li.note: U:quill/mailings: ribbon/mailings.rs: inserts a GREETINGLINE field ("Dear First Last,") directly, as upstream does; Word's Insert Greeting Line dialog is not upstream and stays out.

mailings.write-insert-fields.update-labe.note: U:quill/mailings: Update Labels has no upstream counterpart (labels are made from the recipients in the Labels dialog); hidden.

mailings.write-insert-fields.highlight-m.note: U:quill/mailings: the toggle upstream keeps (merge.highlight); the page shades the merge fields while it is on.

mailings.finish.finish-merge.note: U:quill/mailings: Edit Individual Documents… (which records, then a new document). Hidden (no upstream engine): Print Documents… (no printing) and Send Email Messages… (no mail).

dialog.addressBlock.note: U:quill/mailings: Word's Insert Address Block dialog (name format, company, postal address, country) is not upstream (the engine inserts the field directly, in one fixed format), so the dialog is not offered; the control inserts the field.

dialog.greetingLine.note: U:quill/mailings: Word's Insert Greeting Line dialog (salutation, name format, punctuation, invalid names) is not upstream (the engine inserts the field directly, in one fixed format), so the dialog is not offered; the control inserts the field.
